route_categories.label: Direct answer / 直接作答
route_categories.boundary: Given information is enough; do not call extra tools / 信息足够时不调用额外工具

route_categories.label: Local files / 本地文件
route_categories.boundary: Read the user-scoped workspace; no deletion or configuration change / 只读指定范围，不删除、不改配置

route_categories.label: Public research / 公开调研
route_categories.boundary: Use public sources only; never use logged-in or private data / 只查公开来源，不碰登录态和私有数据

route_categories.label: Documents / 文档交付
route_categories.boundary: Use only for requested Word, PDF, slides, or sheets / 仅用于明确要求的办公文档

route_categories.label: Media / 媒体处理
route_categories.boundary: Use only authorized media; preserve source and license evidence / 仅处理授权素材并保留来源证据

route_categories.label: Browser control / 浏览器控制
route_categories.boundary: Explicitly requested UI work only; logged-in actions need approval / 仅明确要求的界面操作，登录态动作需批准

route_categories.label: GitHub / GitHub 操作
route_categories.boundary: Read first; publishing, PRs, issues, and releases need approval / 先只读，发布、PR、Issue、Release 需批准

route_categories.label: Build and code / 构建与代码
route_categories.boundary: Work inside the requested repository and verify outputs / 只改目标仓库并验证产物

route_categories.label: Governance / 系统治理
route_categories.boundary: Record proposals first; install, enable, disable, hooks, and config need approval / 先记录提案，安装启停和配置需批准
